info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Special Pricing Conditions API
info.description: The Manage Special Pricing Conditions API allows businesses to update and modify existing special pricing conditions associated with banking products. This capability is essential for financial institutions aiming to adjust pricing strategies based on market demands or customer negotiations. Typical consumers include product managers and pricing analysts who require dynamic control over pricing conditions to enhance competitiveness and customer satisfaction. The API facilitates streamlined updates, ensuring pricing accuracy and responsiveness to changing market conditions.

patch.description: This operation allows users to update the details of a specific special pricing condition identified by the resource ID. It enables modifications to pricing strategy and associated rules for better alignment with business objectives.

requestBody.description: Updates specific special pricing conditions for the product identified by RES-100045. Ensure the request body adheres to the required schema to successfully modify the pricing conditions.
